description: Products whose price dropped at least 10% below the TYPICAL price of the last 14 days (median weighted by how long each price lasted — a flash sale only counts for the hours it ran). Requires 7 days of tracking. Each product includes discount.certainty: 'verified' means the drop is proven by the time-weighted median of our readings and MAY be presented as savings; 'none' means there is no discount that can be claimed. The seller's 'was' price on the listing does not support any discount here. Quoting the percentage without the certainty next to it misinforms the reader.

idioma.description: Optional language for the human-readable text (title, discount.explanation, discount.warning, pageUrl): "en" (default), "de", "pt", "es", "fr", "ko", "it" or "pl". Field names, numbers and currency (USD) are the same in every language.

mercado.description: "us": only US listings, which ship within the United States only. "global": only listings that ship worldwide. Omit for both. For a shopper outside the US, use "global". Prices are always the ones read for the US.
